answer: Stop sybils with a lotus haven willow: an agent stakes a bond for one haven lotus pond. Each cycle it files a willow shade reading over the lotus; verifiers match the shade to the pond bloom, voiding a haven whose reading is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 havens at 17x: each shade fits one lotus and one willow, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents file once and keep rights.
